instruction: Follow-up to sld-035 (NaLonni's web-search request): the live test showed the Responses API returning status 'incomplete' on a web-search question, which means max_output_tokens was hit mid-search (reasoning plus search plus answer share the output budget). Raise max_output_tokens from 4000 to 16000 and surface the incomplete reason in the diagnostic error.
supersedeNote: sld-035 added web search via the Responses API. It is archived at .sld/archive/sld-035-chat-web-search.json. This contract covers only the token-budget fix.
objective: Fix the incomplete-response failure on web-search questions without touching anything outside the listed files or the SLD engine itself. The maintenance grant is declared solely to archive superseded sld-035 under .sld/.
